messages:
incidents-bot: PAGER to @oncall-sre: elevated 5xx and connection errors from EU edge -> origin observed across hosted endpoints, alert threshold crossed at 1820499988. https://alerts.internal/INC-2026-03-15-1820500001 :rotating_light:
Alex (oncall-sre): taking. pulling recent traces and edge logs. which CF POPs are noisy?
Priya (infra): quick summary from edge metrics: spike of SSL/TLS handshake failures concentrated in frankfurt and amsterdam PoPs beginning ~09:33 UTC. DNS resolution variance also reported from some edge nodes.
Leo (runtime): sample from our ingress proxies showing upstream errors:
```
2026-03-15T09:35:06Z warn upstream TLS handshake error: remote error: tls: handshake failure, client=\"<>\"
request_id=abc123 host=api.eu.redwood-inference.com
```
Dana (support): weve got ~20 inbound tickets from EU customers saying "timeouts and 5xx since 09:30 UTC". Good to confirm scope before external comms.
cloudflare-bot: We are investigating a regional routing anomaly impacting TLS termination at several EU edge PoPs. Status page: https://status.cloudflare.com/incident/ghijkl
Alex (oncall-sre): preliminary impact: ~15% elevated error rate for eu-hosted API; global control plane unaffected. Marking as partial degradation for EU endpoints.
Priya (infra): hypothesis: inter-PoP certificate sync or routing flap causing some PoPs to present mismatched certs or drop sessions -> handshake aborts. Also seeing occasional 524 from CF to origin.
Leo (runtime): quick mitigation proposals: (A) steer traffic away from impacted CF PoPs via routing policy (B) add origin-override headers to force direct origin TLS for high-value customers (C) temporarily increase HTTP client retries with exponential backoff. Tradeoffs: A fast but may add latency; B bypasses CDN benefits and needs cert validation care; C may increase load/backpressure.
Alex (oncall-sre): start with A + C. enact regional fallback for eu region to nearest healthy PoPs/us-east as needed, and enable retries with jitter for 524/502/525 for 15 minutes. I'll apply routing change now.
Alex (oncall-sre): `/ops/routing apply --selector region=eu --fallback-regions=us-east,eu-south --policy=failover --window=15m`
Priya (infra): applied. monitoring console shows traffic rebalanced within 90s. error rate trending down to ~6%. latency up ~140ms for rerouted requests.
Dana (support): sending initial customer status update: "We are aware of intermittent timeouts for EU hosted API calls. We're actively mitigating with routing changes and working with our CDN partner."
Elena (product): note: identify any Dedicated customers with single-region pinning to frankfurt. we should notify AEs if SLA exposure.
Alex (oncall-sre): collecting packet capture for a failing TLS handshake to attach to CF ticket. Leo, can you run tcpdump on ingress host id go-0 and upload?
Leo (runtime): done. pcap uploaded: s3://incidents/1820500001/tcpdump.pcap (internal). Also saved nginx ssl_error_log snippets.
cloudflare-bot: Update: Engineers are rolling routing fixes; certificate propagation in affected PoPs ongoing.
Priya (infra): quick DNS check: dig from multiple EU vantage points shows inconsistent A answers for `api.eu.redwood-inference.com` from some recursive resolvers. Could be an external DNS caching glitch compounding the PoP problem.
Alex (oncall-sre): mitigations summary so far: routing failover applied, temporary retry bump enabled, keepalive and connection-timeout lowered on edge-facing proxies to reduce hung sockets.
Leo (runtime): patch snippet for retries in client config:
```
httpClient.withRetries({attempts: 4, initialBackoffMs: 100, maxBackoffMs: 900, jitter: true, retryOn: [502,504,524]})
```
Dana (support): outbound customer note sent to ~34 affected customers. few replies asking for ETA.
Alex (oncall-sre): I'm scheduled to hand off in ~25 minutes. Priya, please take lead with Cloudflare ticket and keep incident channel updated. I'll remain on-call for escalation.
Priya (infra): acknowledged. opened Cloudflare case CF-2026-03-15-2217, attached pcap + logs + edge node IDs. CF assigned eng on rotation.
cloudflare-bot: Update: routing recalculation completed for impacted PoPs; certificate sync confirmed as successful in most nodes. Monitoring for residual handshake failures.
Alex (oncall-sre): handoff note: primary changed to Priya at 10:05 UTC. incidents-bot records handoff.
Priya (infra): Cloudflare reports residual 0.2% handshake errors post-rebalance; they recommend keeping failover policy active for 1 hour to ensure stability. Keeping routing policy active.
Elena (product): create a follow-up to evaluate default multi-region failover for hosted EU customers and to surface Dedicated customer pinning risk.
Dana (support): final customer impact summary update: ~60 customers reported intermittent failures, 9 escalated to account teams, no security issues detected. Some customers with high QPS saw increased tail latency during reroute. SLO impact: a small number may qualify for SLA credits.
Alex (oncall-sre): timeline draft for postmortem: detection 09:33 UTC; mitigation routing/ retry 09:38 UTC; handoff 10:05 UTC; CF confirmed rebalancing 10:40 UTC; full recovery 10:50 UTC. total ~1h17m.
Priya (infra): leaving ticket open with Cloudflare for 48h observation and requesting RCA including whether DNS cache TTLs or propagation contributed. Scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
Alex (oncall-sre): action items assigned: Priya - own CF ticket and get RCA; Leo - revert temporary keepalive/timeouts and client retry after 30m; Dana - finalize customer communications and SLA impact table; Elena - product risk review for multi-region failover defaults.
Priya (infra): thanks team. closing loop: error rates to baseline now. will post updates in channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:
Dana (support): will add final incident note to status page once postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
